facts.fact: Zambia Monitor reports the government, with 73Health Global and Pentatech and Finnish support, launched a pilot of remote health diagnostics and AI-based pharmacological analysis tools at 20 health posts across all ten provinces.
facts.system: 73Health remote diagnostics and Larry RX AI pilot

systems.platform: drug interaction and compliance analysis tool

facts.fact: Zambia Monitor says Larry RX AI, a drug interaction and compliance analysis tool developed in Zambia, will be part of the pilot at 20 health posts.
